# `aitbc resource status`

List resource allocations from the coordinator API.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc resource status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | no | Filter by agent ID |
| `--status` | choice | — | no | Filter by allocation status |
| `--limit` | integer | `50` | no | Max allocations to list |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc resource status
```
